Typically, these systems employ an encoder\u2013retriever architecture. However, existing encoders, which rely on pretrained language models, suffer from limited specialization, insufficient awareness of domain knowledge, and biases in user intent understanding. To overcome these limitations, this paper constructs a Chinese corpus specifically tailored for the automotive domain, comprising question\u2013answer pairs, document collections, and multitask annotated data. Subsequently, a pretraining\u2013multitask fine-tuning framework based on masked language models is introduced to integrate domain knowledge as well as enhance semantic representations, thereby yielding benefits for downstream applications. To evaluate system performance, an evaluation dataset is created using ChatGPT, and a novel retrieval task evaluation metric called mean linear window rank (MLWR) is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system (based on BERTbase), achieves accuracies of 77.5% and 84.75% for Hit@1 and Hit@3, respectively, in the automotive domain retrieval-based question-answering task. Additionally, the MLWR reaches 87.71%. Compared to a system utilizing a general encoder, the proposed multitask fine-tuning strategy shows improvements of 12.5%, 12.5%, and 28.16% for Hit@1, Hit@3, and MLWR, respectively. Furthermore, when compared to the best single-task fine-tuning strategy, the enhancements amount to 0.5%, 1.25%, and 0.95% for Hit@1, Hit@3, and MLWR, respectively.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.3390\/math11122733","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2023,6,16]],"date-time":"2023-06-16T08:56:01Z","timestamp":1686905761000},"page":"2733","update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.3390\/mdpi_crossmark_policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":6,"title":["Multitask Fine Tuning on Pretrained Language Model for Retrieval-Based Question Answering in Automotive Domain"],"prefix":"10.3390","volume":"11","author":[{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-2206-1926","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Zhiyi","family":"Luo","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"School of Computer Science and Technology and the Key Laboratory of Intelligent Textile and Flexible Interconnection of Zhejiang Province, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, Hangzhou 310018, China"}],"role":[{"role":"author","vocabulary":"crossref"}]},{"given":"Sirui","family":"Yan","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"School of Computer Science and Technology and the Key Laboratory of Intelligent Textile and Flexible Interconnection of Zhejiang Province, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, Hangzhou 310018, China"}],"role":[{"role":"author","vocabulary":"crossref"}]},{"given":"Shuyun","family":"Luo","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"School of Computer Science and Technology and the Key Laboratory of Intelligent Textile and Flexible Interconnection of Zhejiang Province, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, Hangzhou 310018, China"}],"role":[{"role":"author","vocabulary":"crossref"}]}],"member":"1968","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2023,6,16]]},"reference":[{"key":"ref_1","doi-asserted-by":"crossref","first-page":"213","DOI":"10.1109\/TSA.2005.854085","article-title":"The AT&T spoken language understanding system","volume":"14","author":"Gupta","year":"2005","journal-title":"IEEE Trans. xml:lang=\"fr\">L'\u00e9laboration de r\u00e9ponses aux questions (Question Answering, QA) \u00e0 partir de sources textuelles est un domaine central en traitement automatique du langage naturel (TAL). Les t\u00e2ches de QA impliquent la g\u00e9n\u00e9ration de r\u00e9ponses \u00e0 des questions formul\u00e9es en langage naturel \u00e0 partir de diverses sources textuelles, allant de phrases simples \u00e0 des documents complets. Ce processus n\u00e9cessite une compr\u00e9hension approfondie \u00e0 la fois du contexte et des questions.Les progr\u00e8s r\u00e9cents en QA ont \u00e9t\u00e9 stimul\u00e9s par l'int\u00e9gration des r\u00e9seaux neuronaux, la cr\u00e9ation de vastes ensembles de donn\u00e9es d'entra\u00eenement et l'application de techniques de pr\u00e9-entra\u00eenement non supervis\u00e9. Particuli\u00e8rement apr\u00e8s l'\u00e9mergence de grands mod\u00e8les de langage (LLMs), il est devenu r\u00e9alisable d'unifier diverses t\u00e2ches de TAL sous le cadre de la QA, permettant aux r\u00e9seaux neuronaux de r\u00e9aliser diverses t\u00e2ches simplement en les interpr\u00e9tant comme des questions \u00e0 r\u00e9pondre.Cependant, les mod\u00e8les de QA d\u00e9pendent encore largement de donn\u00e9es annot\u00e9es manuellement, ce qui rend l'entra\u00eenement co\u00fbteux et laborieux. De plus, les LLMs produisent souvent des r\u00e9ponses plausibles mais incorrectes, mettant au d\u00e9fi la fiabilit\u00e9 des syst\u00e8mes de QA.Dans cette th\u00e8se, nous proposons des m\u00e9thodes novatrices pour entra\u00eener efficacement les mod\u00e8les de QA avec des donn\u00e9es limit\u00e9es, visant \u00e0 am\u00e9liorer \u00e0 la fois le rapport co\u00fbt-efficacit\u00e9 et la cr\u00e9dibilit\u00e9 des syst\u00e8mes de QA.Nous abordons d'abord le questionnement extractif au sein de domaines sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9s. Un d\u00e9fi fr\u00e9quent ici est la raret\u00e9 de grands ensembles de donn\u00e9es annot\u00e9s par l'homme. Typiquement, nous avons acc\u00e8s seulement \u00e0 des dizaines ou au plus quelques centaines d'exemples. Nous proposons une m\u00e9thode de fine-tuning qui am\u00e9liore les performances des mod\u00e8les de QA extractifs en utilisant les donn\u00e9es limit\u00e9es disponibles, sans n\u00e9cessiter d'efforts d'annotation suppl\u00e9mentaires.Nous abordons ensuite le probl\u00e8me des hallucinations dans les syst\u00e8mes de questionnement g\u00e9n\u00e9ratif, un d\u00e9fi qui est devenu de plus en plus pr\u00e9dominant avec l'essor des LLMs. Notre deuxi\u00e8me \u00e9tude pr\u00e9sente une autre technique de peaufinage qui att\u00e9nue de mani\u00e8re significative l'effet d'hallucination dans les LLMs pour les t\u00e2ches de questionnement. Notamment, ce peaufinage repose sur des donn\u00e9es contre-factuelles g\u00e9n\u00e9r\u00e9es synth\u00e9tiquement par les LLMs sans intervention humaine.De plus, nous appliquons nos avanc\u00e9es th\u00e9oriques \u00e0 des sc\u00e9narios pratiques tels que l'ach\u00e8vement de graphes de connaissances.
